text: As you know, our planet is facing many environmental problems. What can we do to help?
We should reduce our carbon footprint by using public transport or walking instead of driving.
We also need to recycle more and use less plastic.
Those are excellent suggestions. We can also save energy by turning off lights and appliances when we're not using them.
And planting trees is important too. They absorb carbon dioxide and produce oxygen.
Yes. Every small action counts when it comes to protecting our environment.
